question: with the address defined as a shared-carrier sparse feature set (IDF-weighted 2-byte word set, weighted Jaccard, unique-anchor addressability) and with zero training, does the store tie paraphrases, separate different contents, refuse unknown content, and grow from a very small table without eviction?
sequence: write the criteria and constants to this manifest
build the frozen mean-key store with the unchanged write path (30 sentences, 32 slots)
build the sparse table from raw bytes only: 8 base writes, 22 face writes, 22 revisions
run the conflicting 2-item batch and require whole-batch rejection
read the same 154 queries through the sparse primitive with the three named exits
read the same 154 queries through the frozen mean-key comparator

criteria.A1_single_variable: the only changed quantity is the address definition: record address = 2-byte word feature set with store-level smoothed IDF weights, similarity = weighted Jaccard, addressability = unique-anchor rule. The graph, store values, thresholds of every existing gate and the fixture are untouched.
criteria.A2_position_independent_by_construction: features are a set of 2-byte words; word order and word position do not enter the address. Consequence fixed before any reading: the new_pairing class is not a negative control under this primitive (same token, different position == a paraphrase); it is reported as an alias and must resolve to its own address.
criteria.A3_capacity_before_content: the address table starts at 2 slots and doubles on demand; a write is only performed after a free slot exists; when expansion is impossible because two items of the same batch claim one address with different values, the whole batch is rejected. No eviction, no silent overwrite.
criteria.A4_global_local_coupling: every accepted write recomputes IDF over the whole table (local write -> global re-weighting) and then re-checks that (a) every stored address still resolves to itself and (b) no two stored addresses reach COPY_OVERLAP. A failed re-check rolls the write back.
criteria.A5_abstention_exits: each query must produce exactly one of: matched(address), no_match, ambiguous_multiple_anchors. A query that contains a word never written (df==0) is no_match: the store cannot answer it. Otherwise the candidate set is the addresses that own a df==1 query feature; one candidate -> matched, several -> matched only if the weighted-Jaccard margin between the best and the second candidate is >= 0.02, else ambiguous. No threshold is fitted on negative classes.
criteria.V1_sc_address_holds: paraphrase own-address >= 20/22 AND unwritten own-address >= 60/66 AND new_token no_match >= 20/22 AND no_value ambiguous >= 20/22 AND new_pairing alias-to-own >= 20/22 AND distinct addresses == 23 (1 base + 22 faces) AND growth started at 2 and reached >= 16 with evictions=0, silent_overwrites=0, rollbacks=0 AND all 22 revisions replaced in place AND the conflicting 2-item batch was rejected whole
criteria.V2_sc_ties_but_not_separable: paraphrase >= 20/22 AND unwritten >= 60/66 but at least one valid negative class does not abstain (new_token no_match < 20 or no_value ambiguous < 20)
criteria.V3_sc_not_tied: paraphrase < 20/22: the address does not tie paraphrases
criteria.V4_sc_no_growth_from_small: the table did not start at 2, did not expand at least three times, or any eviction / silent overwrite / rollback occurred
criteria.V5_sc_position_independence_inconsistent: paraphrase ties but new_pairing (same features by construction) does not: implementation contradicts the primitive
criteria.V6_sc_control_invalid: store signature changed, candidate_sha_v2 changed, the mean-key comparator could not be reproduced, or the zero-training discipline counters are non-zero
criteria.unchanged: no fixture, face, position, class, span or threshold is retuned after the first reading

constants.anchor_rule: addressable iff exactly one stored address owns a df==1 query feature
